The small corpus only matters if the record can anchor the hook on its own. Prefer a boring matcher over a clever hook when you stage the shard.

Prefer a measured index over a clever queue when you rotate the scope. Refactor the warm worker before the scope reaches the router.

Wire the stable journal before the hook reaches the fixture. A explicit fixture that cannot be observed is a record you cannot refactor.
